title: Patient Care Desk Training: Counting Courtesy Months on a Second Fee Charge (Savings & Copay Assistance Programs)
content:
Courtesy months on a refunded second Kestrel Rx Savings Club fee charge of the Savings & Copay Assistance Programs run from the date of the second charge to today. How many are counted depends on the member's discounted fills dated fewer than 12 whole months before today:

- a member with **2 or more** such discounted fills has the month in progress counted, so the courtesy months are the **whole months plus one**;
- a member with **no** such discounted fill has only the whole months after the first counted, so the courtesy months are the **whole months less one**;
- a member with **exactly 1** such discounted fill has the **whole months** counted.

**What are the whole months?** The complete months elapsed from the date of the second charge to today.

**Which discounted fills count?** The discounted fills on the membership's program activity dated fewer than 12 whole months before today.

**Hypothetical member, second charge 7 whole months before today:**

| Discounted fills in the last 12 whole months | Courtesy months |
|---|---|
| 0 | 6 |
| 1 | 7 |
| 2 | 8 |
| 5 | 8 |
